R01.text: Over the past 14 days your sleep timing shifted noticeably. During your 28-day baseline you consistently slept ~22:50–07:00 (~470 min). In this window, sleep alternated between two patterns: earlier schedules (~22:15–06:30) and later ones (~00:37–09:00), averaging ~478 min—about 8.5 min longer than baseline. Despite these shifts, total sleep remained consistent day to day. Steps rose slightly (~8052 vs ~7940), while active minutes dipped modestly (~53 vs ~54). Resting heart rate and HRV stayed near baseline levels (~56 bpm, ~45 ms). The alternating sleep schedule is the main change; other metrics remained stable.
